human_repair_overrides.content: \nIdentify the Unaffected Control Children cohort and report its size in hundreds of samples.
Round every VAF to one decimal place, apply the strict rounded-VAF < 0.3 filter, and then remove ontology annotations containing UTR.
Calculate the Benign fraction and multiply it by 100, reporting the result on a 0-to-100 scale.
